acceptanceCriteria: reproduce under load (or a CPU-throttled run) and retain the goroutine dump naming where the package waits
either remove the unbounded wait with a focused test plus one mutation, or record the measured runtime envelope and why it is load-bound, citing decision 0082
body: Observed 2026-10-16 by the V1-1432 timeout lane (PR #968, base 5b6b85441da51a0cfd8e0f3cd325bc131ce985b2, head 3bf9cbc9b) on darwin, 12 cores, load average 65-76: `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./conformance/cli-parity-v0/...` panicked on the 30m per-package hang detector (decision 0082). The lane's change did not touch that package. Expected: the package finishes well inside 30m, or a slow case fails with a named bounded-wait error. Actual: test binary panic with goroutine dump at 30m. Unknown whether it is a real hang (a wait without a deadline) or CPU starvation; the lane did not retain the goroutine dump. Related shapes: V1-1001 (doccorpus/cmd 30m), V1-1421 (real-Git 10s deadlines under load), V1-1493 (CALV0078 load failures).
title: conformance/cli-parity-v0 panics on the 30-minute go test hang detector at host load 65-76
